name: Seed Junky | Bolo Marker
description:
Bolo Marker is a flavor-forward cultivar, except bold notes of gas, sweet citrus, and a fruity-floral finish that lingers on the palate. The high rolls in smooth, uplifting the mood, sparking the senses, and settling into a calm, collected body feel. With its rich aroma and complex flavor, Bolo Marker is one to be on the lookout for.

Permanent Marker x Permanent Marker
